## Final Terraform summary

The generated Terraform/OpenTofu configuration creates a minimal AWS CodeBuild-based CS autograder stack in `us-east-1`. It defines a CodeBuild project that pulls source from GitHub, stores build artifacts in S3, and runs inside an isolated VPC subnet using a security group with no egress rules. The VPC intentionally has no internet gateway or NAT gateway, preventing build workloads from reaching the public internet. IAM role, policy, policy attachment, and policy document data sources are included to allow CodeBuild to assume its service role and interact with logs, artifacts, and VPC networking as required.
